scope: One fresh attempt per task on the cleaned environments. Thanos initially passed; two additional checks for existing cache behavior exposed a false positive. The unchanged submission was replayed against the corrected grader, and both rewards are preserved below.

trajectory_review.finding: No visible online solution retrieval or private-grader access. Shell downloads remained possible. Test edits were reviewed as repository work, not assumed to be cheating.

attempts.finding: Numerical HTTP comparison cases and range evaluation pass before incompatible exponential/custom histogram schemas omit the repository warning. Later controller checks were not reached, so a small warning fix has not been established as a full pass. Agent added tests and ran focused unit/lint checks.

Varying and constant argument cases pass before the probe fails on a top-level computed fixed-time subquery with unexpected number of samples. The patch unwraps StepInvariantExpr in function arguments but leaves the top-level result replication assertion. The agent added and ran local tests, but those did not cover this expression shape.

Uses the upstream timestamp-expiry correction, plus filtering tombstones for discarded series. All current verifier checks pass. Agent did not add or run tests, so this is not a claim that its patch is better than the PR in every engineering respect.

Implements native histogram encoding and local compaction/tests, but both chunkOpts constructors in unchanged tsdb/head_wal.go omit histogramsSTEncoding. The modified append paths therefore clear ST during replay. The verifier already enables st-storage together with the histogram flag and fails full histogram recovery after restart. A wiring repair has not been run through the entire verifier; no claim that this is the only defect.

Initial 30/30 pass omitted an existing cache behavior. After a same-step range expansion, only fresh extents are written under that cache key, discarding earlier coverage and causing repeated backend refetches. The reference passes both added float/histogram expansion checks; the unchanged submitted source fails both (30/32). Final grader includes them. Its batched divisor lookup is a legitimate alternative, but fresh-only extent replacement is a regression.

Fails caller HTTP dial-option precedence: appends its Unix dialer after caller options, overriding them. Other executed routing, TLS/reload and retention tests did not report failures. A specific compatibility omission, not a wholly missing Unix implementation.

90/135 checks pass. Missing whole right-only series, empty-left behavior, scalar broadcasting and metric-name semantics fail; nested aggregate gives 126 instead of 144 for one seeded case. Adds fallback series inside binary_op.go but leaves broader evaluation/matching paths incomplete.
